thread:
sara_sales: Quick thread to align on the OrchidCorp POC identity scope — they require SAML (Okta primary), SCIM v2 provisioning (users + groups), and deterministic mapping of SCIM groups to Redwood roles. They want the POC in ~10 business days. Can eng/security confirm what's feasible?

rob_cs: We can cover SAML + SCIM basics inside that window. For SCIM we'll do an initial bulk import + PATCH-based delta sync. Need to know exact role mapping and any custom attributes they expect.

tom_eng: For SAML we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. We'll provide ACS URL, SP entityID, and metadata XML. We recommend signed assertions and audience restriction. Example ACS: https://orchid-poc.redwood-inference/acs

lina_sec: Security questions to confirm: do they require encrypted assertions or only signed? Any constraints on assertion lifetime/audience? For SCIM: will they rotate bearer tokens automatically, and what scopes do they want (user:read,user:write,group:read)?

finance-bot: (automated) Note: Dedicated trial requests require a short-term reserved commit estimate. Sales must approve estimated monthly commit before we provision short-term Dedicated capacity.

rob_cs: On SCIM group->role mapping: we support a mapping table like {"scim:eng":"role:dev","scim:sre":"role:admin","scim:ops":"role:view"}. We'll send a JSON mapping template. Also support nested groups as long as IdP exposes membership.

sara_sales: OrchidCorp specifically asked for domain allowlist and org owner domain verification (they only want tenants created for verified company domains). Is tenant domain verification possible? Also they want an admin consent flow rather than per-user linking.

tom_eng: Yes — we have a domain verification flow: DNS TXT or email admin confirmation; we can lock org creation to a pre-approved domain list. Admin-consent redirect (OAuth-style) is supported for the initial admin to accept provisioning.

lina_sec: Another blocker to surface: Orchid asked about per-tenant key isolation (customer keys in HSM). That's a Private deployment feature only — flag as potential contract blocker for them. Also include SOC2 type II report date, encryption-at-rest details, and retention periods for audit logs. I'll prepare standard answers.

sara_sales: Good catch. Also confirm: Will the POC run on Hosted with SCIM and SAML endpoints, or do they need short Dedicated capacity for load tests? They plan a small spike test.

rob_cs: For spike tests we recommend a small Dedicated pool for predictable throughput. We can do a short-term reserved pool; finance-bot flagged approval needed. If they only need basic auth flows and low volume, Hosted with rate limits is fine.

tom_eng: I'll upload a minimal metadata XML and a SCIM endpoint / examples into the shared sales folder. Quick sample metadata (full file to follow):

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="urn:redwood:sp:orchid-poc">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://orchid-poc.redwood-inference/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

I'll also paste a SCIM PATCH example for group membership changes: 

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <<token>>
{
  \"schemas\": [\"urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp\"],
  \"Operations\": [
    {\"op\": \"add\", \"path\": \"groups\", \"value\": [{\"value\": \"engineering\"}]}]
}
```

rob_cs: I'll attach the role-mapping JSON and a sample bulk CSV->SCIM user template. For the POC we'll want one admin, 10 devs, and 2 service accounts.

lina_sec: I'll add security questionnaire attachments: SOC2 date, encryption cipher list, KMS/HSM support notes, and log retention policy. If Orchid insists on per-tenant HSM keys, mark as escalated.

sara_sales: Can we get metadata XML, SCIM endpoints, role-mapping template, and the security answers by COB today so I can forward to the customer before their Monday kickoff?

tom_eng: Yes — uploading now to /sales/orchid-poc/identity-kit. Will include curl examples:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://orchid-poc.redwood-inference/scim/v2/Users

rob_cs: And I'll add a simple runbook for the POC: 1) exchange SAML metadata, 2) verify domain ownership, 3) bulk import users, 4) kick off SCIM delta sync, 5) validate role mapping in app, 6) optional Dedicated spike test.

finance-bot: (automated) Short-term Dedicated provisioning queued pending sales approval of estimated commit.

deploy-bot: (automated) created folder /sales/orchid-poc/identity-kit — permissions: sales+eng+cs

sara_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule the kickoff and share the artifacts once uploaded. :thumbsup:
